verdict.rationale: The project documents installing all skills for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi in one non-interactive pass, keeps the three agent copies updated together, and ships Cursor and portable Hermes/Agent Plugins metadata, so cross-agent installation of one collection is a first-party capability. The per-harness instructions are thin: the evidence never shows a separate install procedure for each agent, Cursor support is shown only as a metadata file, and no hands-on corroboration exists. Missing for 10: explicit per-harness install instructions for each agent, documented Cursor install steps, details on other harnesses beyond metadata, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install the same collection into multiple different coding agents — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and others — with per-harness instructions

citations.quote: Install all skills for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi without prompts
Cursor metadata lives in `.cursor-plugin/plugin.json`; portable Hermes/Agent Plugins metadata lives in root `plugin.json`.
